content:
emma_sales: VeloxCare's security returned the questionnaire. They need: Private deployment, original client IP in logs for WAF, single static outbound IP for allowlisting, and whether TLS inspection is possible. Need a brief options summary + ACL snippet and a POC cost delta for procurement.

chris_neteng: Options summary: VPC peering or Transit Gateway => preserves client src IP end-to-end (preferred for WAF). PrivateLink (interface endpoint) does NOT preserve client src IP; traffic egresses from the endpoint ENI. To expose one stable egress IP you must SNAT via a NAT with an EIP in the transit path.

zara_se: Patterns we usually propose:
1) Peering/Transit to our Private VPC (preserves srcip). Requires non-overlapping CIDRs and route propagation.
2) PrivateLink + lightweight proxy in customer VPC that forwards X-Forwarded-For (applications must trust headers).
3) Managed egress NAT (single EIP) — gives stable IP but loses native src IP unless proxy added.

liam_security: TLS inspection caveat: transparent MITM will break cert-pinning. If inspection mandated, recommend a trusted termination proxy under their control or a sidecar that they manage. We support customer-managed KMS and audit export (30/90/365 days) on Private. HSM options available.

emma_sales: Quick ACL snippet (replace CIDRs/EIP):
```
# Allow app subnets to Redwood Private
ALLOW OUT TCP 443 FROM 10.50.0.0/22 TO 198.51.100.0/24
# If using single EIP NAT
NAT 10.50.0.0/22 -> 52.210.45.60
```

chris_neteng: Ballpark POC deltas (very rough): Hosted = pay-per-use. Dedicated reserved = ~$7k-$20k/mo (tier dependent). Private deployment baseline (POC infra + license) = ~$12k-$35k/mo. Add managed static egress = +$800-$2k/mo + per-GB egress. Exact quote from Sales Ops.

emma_sales: Can someone join a short handoff with VeloxCare tomorrow 2pm PT to finalize CIDRs and NAT plan?

chris_neteng: I can. I'll bring route table example and NAT sizing.

zara_se: I'll join for header/proxy guidance.

liam_security: I'll join for KMS/audit wording.

scheduler-bot: Meeting scheduled: VeloxCare-net-handoff on 2025-06-15 14:00 PT. Link: https://meet.redwood.example/veloxcare-1799999991

emma_sales: Thanks — I'll send the invite and attach the ACL + draft security answers. Action items: Chris -> exact NAT EIP cost; Zara -> X-Forwarded-For guidance; Liam -> finalize KMS/audit text.
